[2026 U.S. Women's Open - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_U.S._Women%27s_Open) The 2026 U.S. Women's Open presented by Ally "Ally (bank)") was the 81st U.S. Women's Open, held June 4–7 at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California. Nelly Korda won her fourth major title (and second consecutive), one stroke ahead of runners-up Charley Hull and Gaby López.
